name: Calm Pug 88
author: NomNomcats
description: Neon rounded cyan toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to #4cc9f0, transform becomes translateX(2em), box-shadow becomes 0 2px 4px #000000. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #4cc9f0.
